vahqz9a0.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lamp Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
vahqz9a0.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is designed to bring the spirit of the festive season into your home with its sleek and modern appearance. Its cone-shaped design and dynamic LED light show make it a stunning centerpiece for your seasonal decor, perfect for creating a winter wonderland in both indoor and sheltered outdoor spaces. Crafted from abrasion-resistant materials like PVC and steel, this tree provides a durable and lasting addition to your holiday celebrations. Materials: This tree is crafted from PVC and steel, ensuring an abrasion-resistant and long-lasting build. The materials are selected to maintain their appearance over time, bringing joy year after year without wear. Included Components: It includes an LED string light with dynamic lighting patterns and a USB plug, making it easy to illuminate the space with vibrant lights. A sturdy steel stand is provided to keep the tree stable. Features /Function /Design: With eight LED flash modes, the lighting offers multiple visual experiences, from steady to dynamic displays, allowing you to customize the ambiance according to your mood or event. Recommended Uses: Suitable for the living room, garden, and terrace, this tree's versatility in design shines in any setting, enhancing the festive atmosphere wherever placed. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions using a screwdriver. The non-traditional USB plug offers a universal power source connection, ensuring easy setup and teardown. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Red Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

p0hn91p3.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of the holiday season into your home with this Artificial Christmas Tree, designed in the classic Art Deco style. This cone-shaped decorative piece is perfect for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, offering a vibrant green tone with a luxuriant appearance. The tree's 8 LED flash modes bring warmth and festivity, thanks to the integrated decorative string lights and USB power source that make it both stylish and easy to operate. A lovely addition to your holiday décor, evoking the timeless charm of Christmas. Premium Materials: Crafted from durable PVC and sturdy iron, this artificial tree promises longevity and resilience, standing strong and vibrant throughout the holiday season. The PVC material ensures a lush and realistic foliage appearance, while the iron frame supports and stabilizes its structure, making it a dependable centerpiece for seasonal celebrations. Illuminated Charm: Fitted with warm white LED lights and decorative strings, the tree creates an inviting glow. These energy-efficient lights are evenly spaced, offering consistent illumination and setting a serene holiday mood across any room. Conveniently controlled via USB, altering lighting patterns is effortlessly achieved to enhance different times of day or moods. Collapsible Design: Its innovative, fully collapsible construction facilitates painless assembly and disassembly. Approach storage with ease; once the festivities conclude, the tree neatly folds up, making it practical for those with limited storage space. Stylish Features: Inspired by the opulence of Art Deco, this tree's design adds grandeur to its surroundings, lending an air of sophistication. This striking piece allows you to embellish with ribbons and ornaments, inviting your creativity each year. Care Instructions: Maintain its sheen by wiping with a dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals to preserve its elegant matte finish. Such simple care guarantees that it maintains its brilliance and grace year after year, prolonging joy and holiday tradition. j4f1a7sf.sourceDescription: Sometimes the festive feeling doesn't need a big tree—a small one is enough. This mini Christmas tree has fine, lifelike foliage, like a natural cedar shrunk down and brought indoors—layered and full, never sparse. A light dusting of faux snow settles on the branches, like a quiet snowfall just passed through, and looking at it slows you down. The base is wrapped in linen fabric, adding a touch of rustic charm—placed in the living room, bedroom, hallway, or on an office desk, it doesn't crowd, but warms the corner. It's more than a tree. It's a small canvas waiting for you—string some lights, hang a few ornaments, or pile gifts underneath, and the Christmas feeling starts to spread. It doesn't take much space. The spirit is what matters. Overall Dimension: W40 x D40 x H65cm Recycle your tree through a community program where available. SYL Moda Trading LTD, Po Box 148, Manchester, M266BJ, United Kingdom
